title: Call to Space Command about a classified extraterrestrial threat
summary: John Brandenburg tells of Call to Space Command about a classified extraterrestrial threat, about 1980s at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: some hapless character I called at Space Command. And I said, uh "I've heard there is an extraterrestrial threat whose existence is classified. I'd like to help with that program." And he said, "Oh, okay. Here, let me see if I can connect you with somebody."

plain: A scientist named John Brandenburg says that in the 1980s he phoned Space Command, the part of the US military that handles space, and told the man who answered that he had heard of a secret threat from beings from other worlds and wanted to help with the programme dealing with it. Brandenburg says the man simply said okay and offered to connect him with somebody. He tells it because, if true, it would suggest such a programme was real enough that the man on the phone did not deny it.
